description: This is a Flutter widget implementing a search screen for a recipe application. It includes UI components for inputting search filters such as keywords, ingredients, maximum time, and sorting options. It interacts with a recipe provider to perform recipe searches and displays the results in a list. The file also manages state changes and navigation to a recipe detail screen.

classes.name: SearchScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that provides a UI for searching recipes with various filters.

classes.name: _SearchScreenState
classes.description: State class for SearchScreen, managing search filters, user input, and search result display.

methods.name: _normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a string by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: _parseIngredientCsv
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of ingredients into a list of unique, normalized ingredients.

methods.name: _syncIngredientControllerFromState
methods.description: Synchronizes the ingredient TextEditingController text with the current state of included ingredients.

methods.name: _onKeywordChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the keyword input with debounce to optimize search triggers.

methods.name: _onIngredientsChanged
methods.description: Updates the included ingredients list when the ingredient input changes.

methods.name: _toggleIngredient
methods.description: Adds or removes an ingredient from the included ingredients list based on user interaction.

methods.name: _clearFilters
methods.description: Resets all search filters to default values.

methods.name: _maxTimeLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label for max time filter.

methods.name: _sortLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label for sorting options.

methods.name: _buildFilterPanel
methods.description: Builds the UI panel containing search filters.

methods.name: _openRecipe
methods.description: Navigates to the recipe detail screen for a selected recipe.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the search screen, including filters and results list.
